mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY (USER_ID, ROLE, MESSAGE, ROOM_ID, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{role}, #{message}, #{roomId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID AS roomId, MESSAGE AS message, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDate FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY t1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REG_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(REG_DATE) FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY t2 WHERE t2.ROOM_ID = t1.ROOM_ID AND t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID ) ORDER BY regDate DESC
SELECT ROLE AS role, MESSAGE AS message, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%p %l:%i') AS time FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC

SELECT T.ROOM_ID AS roomId, T.MESSAGE AS lastMessage, IFNULL( ( SELECT SUBSTRING(MESSAGE, 1, 30) FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROOM_ID = T.ROOM_ID AND ROLE = 'user' ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC LIMIT 1 ), '제목 없는 대화' ) AS title, DATE_FORMAT(T.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRegDate FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY T INNER JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_ID, MAX(REG_DATE) AS MAX_REG_DATE FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY ROOM_ID ) M ON T.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID AND T.REG_DATE = M.MAX_REG_DATE WHERE T.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY T.REG_DATE DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}
